projects.title: K-Park Campus Parking System
projects.summary: A campus parking product concept for KFUPM that helps users find, reserve, and manage parking spaces.
projects.details: K-Park combines requirements analysis, UML modeling, and mobile prototype screens for students, faculty, accessibility users, administrators, and security staff.
projects.brief: K-Park is a campus-based parking system designed to reduce the uncertainty of finding parking around KFUPM buildings and open spaces. The concept lets users browse buildings with parking, check available spots, reserve a spot in advance, view reservation history, receive time-limit reminders, and report false parking. It also defines admin and security workflows for managing parking spots, role-based parking areas, overstays, and false parking reports.
projects.impact: Mapped a complete parking journey from authentication to reservation, notification, and operational follow-up.
highlights: Defined functional and non-functional requirements for real-time parking availability, reservations, reminders, and user permissions.
Modeled user, admin, and security workflows through use case, activity, class, and sequence diagrams.
Designed light and dark mobile interface screens for authentication, dashboards, reservations, notifications, accessibility parking, and admin actions.
Included operational controls for adding/removing parking spots, detecting false parking, and notifying security about overstays.

projects.title: Guroosh Personal Finance Platform
projects.summary: A full-stack personal finance platform for expense tracking, investment monitoring, Zakat calculation, and advisor services.
projects.details: Guroosh is a React and Node.js web application that unifies personal finance tracking, real-time portfolio data, Islamic finance calculations, role-based workflows, and admin oversight.
projects.brief: Guroosh is a comprehensive web-based personal finance management platform designed for individual clients, financial advisors, and system administrators. It addresses fragmented financial management by bringing expense tracking, budget monitoring, investment portfolio views, Islamic Zakat calculations, and professional advisor communication into one product. The platform uses role-based access, secure authentication, chart-driven insights, multi-theme UI, and external API integrations for market and gold-price data.
projects.impact: Delivered an end-to-end finance platform concept with client, advisor, and admin experiences supported by modern web architecture.
highlights: Built a role-based product model for clients, financial advisors, and administrators.
Integrated expense tracking, budgets, financial goals, and investment portfolio monitoring across stocks, crypto, gold, and real estate.
Implemented an Islamic finance workflow with Zakat calculation using a gold-based nisab threshold and asset aggregation.
Designed dashboards, charts, authentication flows, advisor request management, admin oversight, and theme settings.
Structured the app around React components, context providers, service-layer API modules, JWT authentication, and MongoDB schemas.
